note: ART Bay Area Sea Level Rise and Shoreline Analysis Maps (AECOM 2017 for BCDC/MTC), flooded area connected to the Bay at total water levels of MHHW plus N inches, rasterized to this grid (a cell is flooded when its center is inside a polygon of any depth class). Source: layers Alameda_inundation_poly_<N> of the Alameda County geodatabase Alameda_SLR_ART_2017.gdb from explorer.adaptingtorisingtides.org/download, all ten levels (SOURCE_NOTES H5). Coordinates: NAD83 / UTM zone 10N in the geodatabase, transformed to the grid's WGS 84 / UTM zone 10N with EPSG:7807 (ITRF2008 to NAD83(2011), inverted) at epoch 2017.0, a shift of about 1.5 m (tools/nad83.mjs; SOURCE_NOTES C1). levelFt = MHHW 6.20 ft NAVD88 at point 518 (W11) + N/12, derived.

datum.from: NAD83 / UTM zone 10N (EPSG:26910; realization taken as NAD83(2011), EPSG:6339)
datum.transformation: EPSG:7807 ITRF2008 to NAD83(2011) (1), inverted; WGS 84 (G1762) taken as ITRF2008
datum.parameters: Pearson and Snay (2013), GPS Solutions 17:1-15: ITRF2008 to NAD83(2011), epoch 1997.0
